title: DHCPFO: Add Microsoft-specific features
description:
See discussion in #19184 

Adds a protocol preference enum: **Microsoft Windows DHCP server compability** (and behaviour changes accordingly, see the commit message)

![image](/uploads/903d2bbad00522c9214252b314b12406/image.png)

Sample capture: [dhcpserver-w2022-server1-failover-with-digest.pcapng](/uploads/af3c325d9f4ad5e747518c77ed317ae9/dhcpserver-w2022-server1-failover-with-digest.pcapng)

Sample from ISC DHCPD for comparison: [dhcpserver-iscdhcpd-server1-failover.pcap](/uploads/d00d6d7f04a18551bf264466409f9693/dhcpserver-iscdhcpd-server1-failover.pcap)

notes.body:
For hardware address handling example, use filter `dhcpfo.msclientscope == 192.168.60.0` and see frame number 38:

```
DHCP Style Option, client-hardware-address (5), 00:0c:29:67:42:7a, 00:0c:29:67:42:7a
    Option Code: client-hardware-address (5)
    Length: 11
    Client DHCP scope (Microsoft-specific): 192.168.60.0
    Client Hardware Type: Ethernet (0x01)
    Client Hardware Address: 00:0c:29:67:42:7a
```

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/11336/diffs?diff_id=725803257&start_sha=a17da66d2308021292c8cdb2623676d6b21bd2e9)

`dhcpfo.msipflags == 3`, frame number 47:

```
DHCP Style Option, IP-flags (12), flags (Microsoft-specific): 0x03
    Option Code: IP-flags (12)
    Length: 1
    IP flags (Microsoft-specific): 0x03
```
This happened when DHCP client had released its lease.

In the draft:
- bit 0 = RESERVED ("IP address [...] is reserved on the server sending the packet")
- bit 1 = BOOTP ("IP address which has been allocated due to an interaction with a BOOTP client (as opposed to a DHCP client)")

and neither of these are true in the example, so the Microsoft-specific flags are unknown.

commits_data.title: DHCPFO: Add Microsoft-specific features
commits_data.message:
DHCPFO: Add Microsoft-specific features

- Add enum preference for autodetecting (or enabling/disabling) Microsoft-
compatibility (default = autodetect)
- Dissect client DHCP scope address (dhcpfo.msclientscope) and hardware address
- Add MS-style IP flags (dhcpfo.msipflags, they do not conform to draft-12)
- Add message digest type 2 as "Microsoft-specific"
- Allow empty message digest (used when message authentication is not
configured)
- Add UTF-16-LE handling for relationship-name and vendor-class options
- Add Microsoft-specific options:
     30 = "microsoft-scope-ID" (dhcpfo.msscopeid)
     33 = "microsoft-scope-netmask" (dhcpfo.msscopenetmask)
     34 = "microsoft-server-IP-address" (dhcpfo.msserverip)

Also show message digest in hex.
